rows.outcome_overview_description: The serotype-specific OPA GMTs for serotypes common to V116 and PNEUMOVAX™23 were determined using the multiplex opsonophagocytic assay (MOPA). Per protocol, within-group measures of dispersion (MOD) were not calculated.
